reply.text:
I like having a date on it. June gives you about six and a half months, which is real time to do this properly.

I can't promise a result, because that depends on your food, your sleep, and how consistent the next 28 weeks are. What I can do is build the training side so it supports getting lean while you keep your strength. Tell me how many days a week you can train and what equipment you have, and the engine will build it. If you want a calorie and macro target, the Targets screen works that out from your weight, activity and goal, and I'll put the button right under this reply.

How many days a week are you realistically looking at?
